description: The file defines the core TensorFlow tensor data structures and functions for creation, serialization, deserialization, and type handling in Go, specifically for the tensorflow/go/tensor.go module.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Represents a multi-dimensional array of elements of a single data type, with methods for creation, reshaping, serialization, and conversion to Go native types.

methods.name: NewTensor
methods.description: Creates a new Tensor from a Go value (scalar, slice, or array), determining shape and data type.

methods.name: ReadTensor
methods.description: Deserializes tensor data from an io.Reader into a Tensor with specified data type and shape.

methods.name: TypeOf
methods.description: Maps a DataType and shape to an equivalent Go reflect.Type.

methods.name: Shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the Tensor as a slice of int64.

methods.name: DataType
methods.description: Returns the DataType (type) of the Tensor.

methods.name: Reshape
methods.description: Attempts to reshape the Tensor to a new shape in place if compatible.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Converts the Tensor to a Go native value (scalar, slice, or array).
